name: @aico/checks
description: The repo gate: aico check (each repo's .st-check.toml stages, quick and full lanes, acceptance on the committed tree), aico commit (path-scoped) and the acceptance run.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --log-level=error --outfile=dist/aico-checks.mjs --banner:js="// Aico checks bundle. Built by npm run build; do not edit."
